ui.hub.pages.browse_aria: accessible name for the section tab list
The three tabs switch what the hub lists (agents, teams, skills). No visible label, so this is the group's only name.

ui.hub.pages.card.get.role: Download button label on a public hub card
ui.hub.pages.card.get.tone: Imperative verb, shortest possible; sentence case.
ui.hub.pages.card.get.length_hint: Three characters in English. It sits in a small secondary button beside a download icon in the card footer; keep it to one short word, or the footer's action row wraps.
ui.hub.pages.card.get.note: The accessible name on the same button is the sentence 'Download {name}', a separate message; this key is the visible word only.

ui.hub.pages.card.updated.role: Provenance fragment on a public hub card, after the author and a dot
ui.hub.pages.card.updated.tone: Quiet, lowercase fragment; it continues a dot-separated line, so it does not start a sentence.
ui.hub.pages.card.updated.length_hint: Two words plus the age in English. The line truncates with an ellipsis inside a card that is about 280 px wide, so keep the surrounding words short.

placeholders.when: The localized age phrase, for example '4 days ago' or 'just now', produced by the hub's shared age messages (ui.hub.comments.age.*). It already contains its own 'ago'; do not add another. Translate the verb around it, never the age itself.

ui.hub.pages.card.updated.note: One whole sentence, so a language that puts the time before the verb can reorder it. Agent Hub cards describe an agent the author last changed at this age.

ui.hub.pages.header.subtitle: page subtitle
plain, one line of scope
Names the three things the hub holds and the company it comes from. Radient is a product name and stays English. Wraps under the title on narrow widths.
ui.hub.pages.header.title: page title
plain, product name
The surface's own name in the app's navigation vocabulary; 'Agent Hub' is the shipped English name and the sidebar uses it too.

ui.hub.pages.orgs_below_version.note: Local Operator is a product name. The remedy is an update, not a retry: an older backend answers the same refusal forever. Two sentences; wraps under the key alert title.
ui.hub.pages.orgs_below_version.role: alert body when the backend predates org operations
ui.hub.pages.orgs_below_version.tone: calm, names the remedy that works

ui.hub.pages.orgs_unavailable: The viewer is signed in but the backend cannot serve organization scopes, so only the public hub is readable. The sentence explaining why is a shared backend message, not this key.
ui.hub.pages.publish: button label in the empty roster
Opens the agents page where a new agent is published. Sentence case, one line beside the empty-state copy.
ui.hub.pages.scope.org_label: Used when an organization has no readable name; the chip normally shows the tenant name as data. Truncates at max-w-48, so keep it short.
ui.hub.pages.scope.org_unnamed: Names the organization whose shared hub is being read when its name is unknown. Flows inside status.scope.shared_with, so it must read as a noun phrase, not a sentence.
ui.hub.pages.scope.public: The public half of the hub, as opposed to one organization's. Shares a segmented row with organization chips; 'Public hub' is shipped terminology.
ui.hub.pages.scope_label: visible label beside the scope chips
Says what the chip group chooses. aria-hidden because the fieldset legend carries the same fact for assistive tech; small meta weight.
ui.hub.pages.scope_legend: screen-reader legend for the scope chips
The group picks WHICH hub is shown: the public one or one organization's. Ends the sentence the chips complete.
ui.hub.pages.search.aria: accessible name for the hub search input
Stable whatever the scope selector says, because the accessible name must not change under focus. Names the records searched.
ui.hub.pages.search.placeholder: placeholder in the hub search input
Deliberately does not name the searched field: the segment to its right does. Same input width as the aria name's wording allows.
ui.hub.pages.search.scope_aria: accessible name for the field-scope select
Names what the adjacent select chooses: which field the query is matched against (name or description).
ui.hub.pages.search_field.description: option label in the field-scope select
Search matches the description field only. Paired with search_field.name in one select.
ui.hub.pages.search_field.name: option label in the field-scope select
plain, one word
Search matches the name field only. Paired with search_field.description; the select is narrow, so keep both short.
ui.hub.pages.sort.aria: accessible name for the sort select
Names the ordering control. The visible trigger shows the current option's label, so this only has to say what the control is.
ui.hub.pages.sort.most_downloaded: Orders by download count, highest first. Select trigger is w-48; keep it within that box without truncation where the language allows.
ui.hub.pages.sort.most_favourited: Orders by favourite count, highest first. Distinct from most_liked: the star and the heart are different actions.
ui.hub.pages.sort.most_liked: Orders by like count, highest first. Keep the like/favourite distinction the two controls make.
ui.hub.pages.sort.name_asc: Alphabetical by display name, ascending. The parenthetical carries the direction and the alphabet assumption; use the locale's customary phrase.
ui.hub.pages.sort.newest: Orders by creation date, newest first. Short label in a w-48 trigger.
ui.hub.pages.sort.recently_updated: Orders by last-modified time, most recent first. Distinct from newest (creation date).
ui.hub.pages.status.agents_scope: status line under the browse bar
Shown when the count is not known yet (a failed or pending read): says which list is being read. {scope} is status.scope.public or status.scope.shared_with.
ui.hub.pages.status.count.agents: {count} is a record count and takes an ICU plural; {scope} is one of the scope phrases and joins the sentence the locale's way. The line keeps one line box in every state.
ui.hub.pages.status.count.teams: status line, teams view with an organization scope
Team counterpart of status.count.agents: {count} takes an ICU plural and {scope} is the organization phrase. Public teams show no count line at all.
ui.hub.pages.status.loading_agents: status line while the first agents read runs
Cold-loading state of the agents view. U+2026 rather than three periods.
ui.hub.pages.status.loading_teams: status line while an organization's teams read runs
Only the organization teams view uses this; the public teams catalogue owns its own line.
ui.hub.pages.status.scope.public: fragment appended to a count or a list name
Says the records come from the public hub. A sentence fragment by design: it completes status.count.* and status.*_scope.
ui.hub.pages.status.scope.shared_with: fragment appended to a count or a list name
{org} is the organization's name, user data of unknown length, or scope.org_unnamed when it has none. Fragment, not a sentence.
ui.hub.pages.status.teams_scope: status line under the browse bar
Teams counterpart of status.agents_scope for an organization whose teams could not be counted. {scope} is the scope phrase.
ui.hub.pages.tab.agents: First of the three section tabs. A live count sits beside it in a two-character slot, so keep it short.
ui.hub.pages.tab.teams: Second section tab; pairs with tab.agents and shares its count slot.
ui.hub.pages.updating: Says a refresh is in flight while the previous result stays on screen. U+2026, not three periods; sits mid-sentence after a count.
ui.hub.pages.viewer_unknown: status sentence in an output element
One failed batched read means no card can show like/favourite state, so this says why once rather than letting every card read as 'not liked'. Full sentence; wraps.
ui.hub.pages.pager.nav_aria: The hub grid's page footer. Keep Agent Hub's vocabulary ('agents') so the landmark and the page agree.
ui.hub.pages.pager.next: Visible word beside the chevron; the accessible name is the button's own 'Next page'.
ui.hub.pages.pager.previous: Visible word beside the chevron; the accessible name is the button's own 'Previous page'.

ui.hub.pages.signed_out.title.role: heading of the Agent Hub error alert when the user is not signed in to Radient
ui.hub.pages.signed_out.title.tone: imperative heading, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.hub.pages.signed_out.title.note: Shown instead of an outage message, because the failure is the missing credential, not the hub.

ui.hub.pages.signed_out.body.role: body of the Agent Hub alert explaining why the list cannot load and what to do
ui.hub.pages.signed_out.body.tone: plain two-sentence explanation, second person, sentence case
ui.hub.pages.signed_out.body.note: 'Radient' is the product/account name and stays verbatim. Names the next step (sign in on the settings page) and then the Try again button under it.

ui.hub.pages.load_failed.title.role: heading of the Agent Hub error alert for a real load failure
ui.hub.pages.load_failed.title.tone: plain statement, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.hub.pages.load_failed.title.note: Used only when the user IS signed in; the sign-in case has its own heading.

ui.hub.pages.list_unreadable.role: lead sentence of the agent grid's load-failure alert, the first of three joined sentences
ui.hub.pages.list_unreadable.tone: plain statement, sentence case, trailing full stop
ui.hub.pages.list_unreadable.note: The call site joins this with a shared diagnosis sentence and a shared remedy sentence, so it MUST end in a full stop and must not name a remedy itself. 'The agent list' is what failed to read, not the whole hub (the hub shell rendered).

ui.hub.pages.org.plan_headline.role: headline of the warning alert when an organization's hub is refused for want of the Team plan
ui.hub.pages.org.plan_headline.tone: plain statement, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.hub.pages.org.plan_headline.note: Pairs with org.plan_body. Deliberately does NOT open with 'The hub could not be loaded': a lapsed plan is retried into the same refusal, so that wording would send the reader to a control that cannot work.

ui.hub.pages.org.no_access_headline.role: headline of the warning alert when the viewer is not a member of the organization whose hub was asked for
ui.hub.pages.org.no_access_headline.tone: plain statement, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.hub.pages.org.no_access_headline.note: Pairs with org.no_access_body. 'that organization' is a deictic pointing at the scope chip still on screen; keep both keys using the same demonstrative.

ui.hub.pages.org.plan_body.role: body of the Team-plan refusal alert
ui.hub.pages.org.plan_body.tone: plain two-sentence explanation, third person about the organization's owner
ui.hub.pages.org.plan_body.length: Two sentences, about thirty-five words in English.
ui.hub.pages.org.plan_body.note: Names who can fix it (an owner) and where (the Radient console). 'Radient' and 'Team plan' are product names and stay verbatim. Mirrors the flagship wording of ui.hub.teams.org.plan_body, which says the same thing for teams; keep the two parallel in a given language.

placeholders.org: The organization's display name, or the noun phrase from org.that_organization / scope.org_unnamed when its name is unknown. Do not translate the name itself.

ui.hub.pages.org.no_access_body.role: body of the not-a-member refusal alert
ui.hub.pages.org.no_access_body.tone: plain two-sentence explanation, second person, quiet
ui.hub.pages.org.no_access_body.length: Two sentences, about twenty words in English.
ui.hub.pages.org.no_access_body.note: Ends with the one remedy that exists for this reader (an owner can invite them again); there is no control on this surface that fixes it, so do not invent one. Mirrors ui.hub.teams.org.no_access_body for teams.

placeholders.org: The organization's display name, or the noun phrase from org.that_organization when its name is unknown. Do not translate the name itself.

ui.hub.pages.org.that_organization.role: fallback noun phrase inside the not-a-member sentence, used when the organization has no readable name
ui.hub.pages.org.that_organization.note: Flows inside org.no_access_body where a name would otherwise sit, so it must be a NOUN PHRASE that takes the sentence's preposition, not a sentence. The demonstrative must agree with org.no_access_headline's.

ui.hub.pages.empty.org.title.role: heading of the empty grid when scoped to an organization that has shared no agents
ui.hub.pages.empty.org.title.tone: plain factual statement, sentence case, trailing full stop
ui.hub.pages.empty.org.title.note: One of four mutually exclusive empty headings (org, category, search, public); they share one slot, so keep them similar in length or the panel reflows between scopes.

ui.hub.pages.empty.org.body.role: second line of the empty grid when scoped to an organization
ui.hub.pages.empty.org.body.tone: plain statement of what will appear, third person
ui.hub.pages.empty.org.body.length: One sentence, about eleven words in English.
ui.hub.pages.empty.org.body.note: Says who the list is FOR (its members) because an organization's hub is private. Deliberately not the public hub's 'Yours could be the first': that invites a public publication on a surface only one organization can see.

placeholders.org: The organization's display name, or the noun phrase from scope.org_unnamed when its name is unknown.

ui.hub.pages.empty.category.title.role: heading of the empty grid when a type/category filter matches nothing
ui.hub.pages.empty.category.title.tone: plain factual statement, sentence case, trailing full stop
ui.hub.pages.empty.category.title.length: Five words plus the category in English.
ui.hub.pages.empty.category.title.note: Shares its slot with empty.search.title and empty.public.title.

placeholders.category: The category's own display label, already translated and already named for the reader; insert it whole, do not decline or re-case it.

ui.hub.pages.empty.category.body.role: second line of the empty grid for a category miss, naming the control that clears it
ui.hub.pages.empty.category.body.tone: plain two-sentence explanation, imperative second sentence
ui.hub.pages.empty.category.body.length: Two sentences, about thirteen words in English.
ui.hub.pages.empty.category.body.note: Must use the SAME noun as clear.filter, because the button under it is labelled with that word. This is why the category miss and the search miss have separate bodies.

ui.hub.pages.empty.search.title.role: heading of the empty grid when the typed query matches nothing
ui.hub.pages.empty.search.title.tone: plain factual statement, sentence case, trailing full stop
ui.hub.pages.empty.search.title.note: Shares its slot with empty.category.title and empty.public.title.

ui.hub.pages.empty.search.body.role: second line of the empty grid for a query miss, naming the control that clears it
ui.hub.pages.empty.search.body.tone: plain two-sentence explanation, imperative second sentence
ui.hub.pages.empty.search.body.length: Two sentences, about fifteen words in English.
ui.hub.pages.empty.search.body.note: Says what the search covered (the agent's name or description) and must use the same noun as clear.search. Written for a query the reader TYPED, so it must not use the category miss's 'carries that filter' phrasing.

ui.hub.pages.empty.public.title.role: heading of the empty grid when nothing has been published to the public hub at all
ui.hub.pages.empty.public.title.tone: plain factual statement, sentence case, trailing full stop
ui.hub.pages.empty.public.title.note: Shares its slot with the category and search misses; this is the no-filter case.

ui.hub.pages.empty.public.body.role: second line of the empty public hub, inviting the reader to publish
ui.hub.pages.empty.public.body.tone: plain two-sentence explanation, second person, quietly encouraging
ui.hub.pages.empty.public.body.length: Two sentences, about eleven words in English.
ui.hub.pages.empty.public.body.note: Invites a public publication, so it is used only on the public scope; an organization's hub has its own body. 'Yours' refers to the reader's own agent.

ui.hub.pages.clear.filter.role: button label that clears the category filter from the empty-grid panel
ui.hub.pages.clear.filter.tone: imperative verb and its object, sentence case, no punctuation
ui.hub.pages.clear.filter.length: Two words in English; the panel can hold a longer label without wrapping.
ui.hub.pages.clear.filter.note: Names the FILTER rather than the search, because the reader switched a category. Must use the same noun as empty.category.body.

ui.hub.pages.clear.search.role: button label that clears the typed query from the empty-grid panel
ui.hub.pages.clear.search.tone: imperative verb and its object, sentence case, no punctuation
ui.hub.pages.clear.search.note: Names the SEARCH because the reader typed a query. Must use the same noun as empty.search.body.
